QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] A Meeting with Kamaitachi
QuestInfo.0: You gather #t4009380# and restore all the Sacred Idols. But why are the Oni still hostile?
QuestInfo.1: You run into #p9111012#, some kind of talking weasel. It seems he knows #p9111011#. Defeat the attacking Oni and listen to what he has to say.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the attacking Oni! You should ask #p9111012# what happened.
